info.title: orders-sut API
info.description: A small orders service built as a system under test. Money is in integer cents. Errors always look like {"error": {"code", "message", "details?"}}.

post.summary: Log in and get a bearer token (valid for 1 hour)

get.summary: List active products, sorted by name

patch.summary: Change price, stock or visibility (admin). Existing orders keep their prices.

post.summary: Check a coupon against a subtotal without using it
Create an order; reserves stock and uses the coupon

get.summary: List orders, newest first. Customers see their own, admins see all.
Get an order. Someone else's order looks like a missing one (404).

post.summary: Pay a NEW order (owner only). Send Idempotency-Key to make retries safe. Tokens: tok_ok, tok_declined, tok_insufficient, tok_timeout, tok_error.
Cancel a NEW order (-> CANCELLED) or refund a PAID one (-> REFUNDED)

get.summary: Get an order in the v2 shape (nested totals, coupon and payment objects)

post.summary: Wipe all data, reset the clock and chaos flags. baseline=true re-seeds the default dataset.
Create exactly the entities you describe, in one transaction. Orders may be given any status and createdAt; they do not touch stock or coupon usage.
Move application time. now sets it (frozen unless freeze=false), advanceMs moves it forward, reset returns to real time.

put.summary: Merge the given chaos flags into the current ones

post.summary: Run the order-expiry sweep now: cancels NEW orders older than 30 minutes (by the app clock).
Mint a bearer token for an existing user without a password (skips the login screen)
